forms[4].detail: the joint report gives more than 200 kg of powder in more than 4,500 cases and about 30,000 tablets in over 500 cases; 'in over 500 cases' should go with the tablets only (re-fetch 58c).
street_names[11].period: no year is given for the Slovak products (Long Play, Beep Beep, Speed Way, Popeyes Sniff, LP) in this reading (re-fetch 58c).

forms[9].detail: the 5,970 kg for 2024 sits in a sentence about Netherlands imports from India; its 53.7% share is of the overall total, so it is probably the 2024 total, but the report does not say so explicitly.
NIST does not label its 'Other names' as CAS index names; ATC pages are not among this page's sources, so 'INN status not confirmed' items are confirmed as statements about the sources read.
Street-name regions taken from the US DEA are not stated on the pages; they are confirmed as the publisher's jurisdiction.
forms[7].detail: re-fetch 64c reads the annex's 1,400 kg as seizures at the external EU border originating in India, not as a second figure for the same 2021 total; the wording could say so.

drug_checking[1].finding: the report gives 197 of the January-March 2025 samples (92.9%) as sold as 3-MMC without naming the Netherlands for that figure; the Netherlands reported 212 of the 213 samples and Spain's one was sold as 4-MMC (re-fetch 68c).
